integrity: The qutrit QFI family and source date were checked against arXiv:2609.31601v1. The proof reconstructs the weighted 2-by-2 semidefinite optimization directly and separates what is inherited from prior MLD theory from the new block-weight classification.
limitations: The theorem covers positive-definite weights with no coupling between the first two parameter directions and the third; it does not solve the fully general 3-by-3 weight problem or assert finite-copy attainability.
title: Block-weight phase diagram for the qutrit Holevo–MLD separation
